title: GPU Setup & Cloud
motto: Training on CPU is fine for learning. Training for real needs a GPU.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Training on CPU is fine for learning. Training for real needs a GPU.

steps.title: When you need a GPU
cards: Phases 1–3 often run on CPU. CNNs, transformers, and LLM training (phase 4+) need GPU acceleration — 8 hours on CPU can become 10 minutes on GPU.
Options: local NVIDIA GPU, Google Colab (free T4), or cloud GPU (Lambda, RunPod). No GPU? Most lessons still work; heavy ones include Colab links.

steps.title: Device selection pattern
steps.body: Every PyTorch script starts with device = cuda if available else mps (Apple) else cpu. This one line is the bridge between your laptop and cloud GPUs.

steps.title: Implement pick_device
steps.body: Mirror torch.device logic: prefer cuda, then mps (Apple Silicon), else cpu. No torch import needed.
